title: Founders of Washington copied Egypt with obelisks
place_text: Washington DC; Central Park; France; England

tellings.quote: he explained to me what they knew and how the the people that set Washington up, they did the same thing.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him, says a man named Robert Gilbert explained to him that the people who laid out Washington, DC copied ancient Egypt by raising obelisks, tall four-sided stone pillars. Bledsoe says the same was done in Central Park, France and England. If true, it would mean the city's founders were following an old, hidden tradition.
